none: PAS CAM-D0C5F4: Roman Coin : copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II as Caesar (AD 323-337)
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ [*..]VS NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II as Caesar (AD 323-337) (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers with one standard. Mint is Trier, (AD 335-337). See RIC vol.VII, p.223, cf.no.592. Obverse legend reads [*..]VS NOB C. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//(.TRP)[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock.
